title: LibScript Base Component Variables
description: Common variables shared by all LibScript components

LIBSCRIPT_DEFAULT_INSTALL_METHOD.description: Global override for how software should be installed ('libscript_native' prebuilt binary, 'from-source' compiled from source code, or 'system' via OS/selected package manager).

LIBSCRIPT_PKG_MGR.description: Explicit package manager override for 'system' or package-manager-driven installations (e.g., 'apt-get', 'apk', 'dnf', 'yum', 'zypper', 'pacman', 'brew', 'port', 'pkg', 'xbps', 'emerge', 'winget', 'choco', 'scoop', 'nix', 'guix', 'spack', 'vcpkg', 'conan'). When set, overrides auto-detection in detect_pkg_mgr.

LIBSCRIPT_BUILD_TOOLCHAIN.description: Toolchain selector used when building components from source ('default' uses the platform default C/C++ compiler via _lib/languages/c, whereas 'gcc', 'clang', 'tcc', 'custom-cc', or an explicit binary path compiles the component with that specific toolchain).

LIBSCRIPT_CUSTOM_CC_BIN.description: Optional filesystem path to a custom C compiler binary when LIBSCRIPT_BUILD_TOOLCHAIN='custom-cc'.

LIBSCRIPT_BUILD_CFLAGS.description: Global extra CFLAGS passed to source builds across components.

LIBSCRIPT_BUILD_LDFLAGS.description: Global extra LDFLAGS passed to source builds across components.

LIBSCRIPT_WINDOWS_PKG_MGR.description: Global package manager override for Windows (winget, choco, scoop, vcpkg).

LIBSCRIPT_LOG_FILE.description: File to write logs to (in addition to standard output).

LIBSCRIPT_CACHE_DIR.description: Directory where cached files are stored.

LIBSCRIPT_OFFLINE.description: Flag (0 or 1) indicating whether offline mode is active, prohibiting outgoing network calls.

LIBSCRIPT_FORCE_OFFLINE.description: Strict offline flag (0 or 1) that immediately aborts execution if network calls are attempted.

LIBSCRIPT_DOWNLOAD_DIR.description: Staging directory for temporary download artifacts.

LOGS_DIR.description: Directory where logs should be stored.

SERVE_FROM.description: Base directory or context path for the service.

LIBSCRIPT_VERSION.description: Specifies the version of the package to use.

XPK_CLUSTER_NAME.description: Name for the XPK GKE cluster

TPU_TENSOR_PARALLEL_SIZE.description: Tensor parallel size for TPU serving

JETSTREAM_IMAGE.description: Docker image for JetStream TPU inference

LIBSCRIPT_HOME.description: Base installation prefix where LibScript installs isolated component versions.

LIBSCRIPT_DATA_DIR.description: Base data directory for runtime component state, databases, and service configurations.

LIBSCRIPT_BUILD_DIR.description: Scratch build directory used when compiling components from source.

LIBSCRIPT_TARGET_SYSROOT.description: Optional target root filesystem path when provisioning chroots or OS images.

LIBSCRIPT_SKIP_SYSTEM_DEPS.description: Flag (0 or 1) to skip OS-level system dependency installation during setup.

LIBSCRIPT_DRY_RUN_PKG_MGR.description: Flag (0 or 1) to simulate package manager operations without mutating the system.

LIBSCRIPT_DRY_RUN.description: Flag (0 or 1) to simulate lifecycle and service operations without executing mutating commands.

LIBSCRIPT_MOCK_SYSTEMD.description: Flag (0 or 1) to mock systemd service management calls during testing.

LIBSCRIPT_SYSTEMD_DIR.description: Override directory for systemd unit and drop-in override files (defaults to /etc/systemd/system).

LIBSCRIPT_ETC_DIR.description: Override root configuration directory for system service config files (defaults to /etc).

LIBSCRIPT_OVERRIDE_CHANGED.description: Internal flag (0 or 1) set by libscript_override_service_env when a service environment file was modified.

LIBSCRIPT_ARIA2_EXPORT_FILE.description: File path to export aria2-compatible download URLs instead of downloading immediately.

LIBSCRIPT_NEVER_REFRESH_CHECKSUM_DB.description: Flag (0 or 1) to prevent auto-fetching remote SHA-256 checksums when missing from checksums.txt.

LIBSCRIPT_DISABLE_CHECKSUM_TXT_UPDATE.description: Flag (0 or 1) to prevent appending newly discovered SHA-256 hashes to _lib/checksums.txt.

LIBSCRIPT_LISTEN_PORT.description: Global fallback TCP port for network-listening components.

LIBSCRIPT_LISTEN_ADDRESS.description: Global fallback bind address for network-listening components.

LIBSCRIPT_LISTEN_SOCKET.description: Global fallback UNIX domain socket path for listening components.

LIBSCRIPT_SERVICE_RUN_AS_USER.description: System user account under which daemonized services should execute.

LIBSCRIPT_GLOBAL_INSTALL_METHOD.description: Global installation strategy override applied across all components.

FORCE_REINSTALL.description: Flag (0 or 1) to force re-downloading and reinstalling a component even if already present.

FORCE_REBUILD.description: Flag (0 or 1) to force rebuilding a component or service unit from scratch.

LIBSCRIPT_ALLOW_ANY_TAG_MANIPULATION.description: Flag (0 or 1) allowing cloud provider teardown operations to modify resources without matching tag filters.

LIBSCRIPT_AZURE_RESOURCE_GROUP.description: Default Azure Resource Group name for cloud provisioning operations.

LIBSCRIPT_DASHBOARD_DIR.description: Directory path for generated monitoring and observability dashboards.

LIBSCRIPT_DEBUG.description: Flag (0 or 1) enabling verbose debug tracing across LibScript lifecycle actions.

LIBSCRIPT_FORCE_FETCH.description: Flag (0 or 1) forcing remote artifact re-fetching even when present in local cache.

LIBSCRIPT_HOST_ROOT.description: Host root directory mount point when executing inside a container or chroot.

LIBSCRIPT_HW_CORES.description: Detected or overridden CPU core count for auto-tuning services and parallel builds.

LIBSCRIPT_HW_MEM_MB.description: Detected or overridden system memory in MiB for auto-tuning service buffer pools.

LIBSCRIPT_HW_NVME.description: Detected or overridden NVMe storage presence flag for I/O scheduler and database tuning.

LIBSCRIPT_HW_SIMD.description: Detected or overridden CPU SIMD instruction set capabilities (e.g., avx2, avx512, neon).

LIBSCRIPT_PROFILE.description: Active configuration profile name (e.g., dev, prod, minimal, hpc).

LIBSCRIPT_RESOLVED_CC_BIN.description: Resolved path to the active C compiler binary for source builds.

LIBSCRIPT_RESOLVED_CC_ID.description: Resolved compiler identifier (gcc, clang, tcc, msvc) for source builds.

LIBSCRIPT_RESOLVED_CC_VERSION.description: Resolved version string of the active C compiler.

LIBSCRIPT_SOURCE_WORKDIR.description: Working directory used for extracting and compiling source tarballs.

LIBSCRIPT_TAG_ENABLE.description: Flag (0 or 1) enabling resource tagging on cloud provider assets.

LIBSCRIPT_TAG_KEY.description: Tag key applied to provisioned cloud provider resources.

LIBSCRIPT_TAG_VALUE.description: Tag value applied to provisioned cloud provider resources.

LIBSCRIPT_TARGET_ARCH.description: Target CPU architecture when cross-compiling or building OS images.

LIBSCRIPT_TARGET_LIBC.description: Target C standard library implementation (glibc, musl, uclibc, msvcrt).

LIBSCRIPT_TARGET_OS.description: Target operating system identifier when provisioning or cross-compiling.

LIBSCRIPT_TARGET_ROOTFS.description: Filesystem path to the target rootfs directory for image synthesis.

LIBSCRIPT_VOLUME_NAME.description: Logical storage volume name for persistent data mounts.

LIBSCRIPT_LIB_SYSTEMD_DIR.description: Override directory for vendor systemd unit files (defaults to /lib/systemd/system).

LIBSCRIPT_EXPORT_STAGE_DIR.description: Staging directory used when exporting application and database state archives.

LIBSCRIPT_IMPORT_STAGE_DIR.description: Staging directory used when importing application and database state archives.

LIBSCRIPT_HOME_BASE.description: Base parent directory for user home directories (defaults to /home).

LIBSCRIPT_ROOT_HOME.description: Root user home directory override (defaults to /root).

LIBSCRIPT_USR_LOCAL_BIN.description: Override directory for locally installed system binaries (defaults to /usr/local/bin).

LIBSCRIPT_USR_LOCAL_ETC.description: Override directory for locally installed system configuration files (defaults to /usr/local/etc).

LIBSCRIPT_FREEBSD_RCD_DIR.description: Override directory for FreeBSD rc.d service scripts (defaults to /usr/local/etc/rc.d).

LIBSCRIPT_INITD_DIR.description: Override directory for SysV/OpenRC init.d scripts (defaults to /etc/init.d).

LIBSCRIPT_BENCH_PREPARE_HOST.description: Flag (0 or 1) to lock CPU frequency scaling governor to performance, disable ASLR, and disable swap before running compiler benchmarks.

LIBSCRIPT_BENCH_DROP_CACHES.description: Flag (0 or 1) to flush filesystem buffers and drop OS page caches before each compiler benchmark run.

LIBSCRIPT_RESOLVED_CXX_BIN.description: Resolved path to the active C++ compiler driver executable (e.g. g++, clang++, edg-c++) selected by libscript_resolve_build_toolchain.

LIBSCRIPT_LAST_PEAK_RSS_KB.description: Peak resident set size (in kilobytes) recorded during the most recent source build invocation.

LIBSCRIPT_EXPERIMENT_PROVIDER.description: Default cloud vendor for rapid experimentation (defaults to 'azure').

LIBSCRIPT_EXPERIMENT_SIZE.description: Default instance size for rapid experimentation (defaults to '160-vCPU Standard_D160ads_v7').

LIBSCRIPT_EXPERIMENT_NODE.description: Default compute node name for rapid cloud experimentation.

LIBSCRIPT_EXPERIMENT_RG.description: Default resource group for rapid cloud experimentation.

LIBSCRIPT_EXPERIMENT_LOCATION.description: Default cloud location/region for rapid cloud experimentation.

LIBSCRIPT_EXPERIMENT_OS.description: Default VM operating system image for rapid cloud experimentation.

LIBSCRIPT_EXPERIMENT_SUITE_MANIFEST.description: Path to a declarative experiment-suite.schema.json manifest file executed by the experiment runner.

LIBSCRIPT_EXPERIMENT_WARMUP.description: Default number of unrecorded warmup runs executed before recorded benchmark trials (defaults to '10').

LIBSCRIPT_EXPERIMENT_TRIALS.description: Default number of recorded fresh trials captured per benchmark cell (defaults to '200').

LIBSCRIPT_EXPERIMENT_SUBSUITES.description: Comma- or space-separated list of sub-suite identifiers to execute (e.g., 'E0,E1,E2,E3,E4,E5,E6,E7,E8').

LIBSCRIPT_EXPERIMENT_OUT_DIR.description: Output directory for mechanical experiment JSON results and generated LaTeX macros.

LIBSCRIPT_EXPERIMENT_REPO_DIR.description: Local or synced remote filesystem path to the target repository under benchmark evaluation.

LIBSCRIPT_EXPERIMENT_PAPER_DIR.description: Local or synced remote filesystem path to the paper manuscript directory receiving generated LaTeX metrics.

LIBSCRIPT_EXPERIMENT_ECOSYSTEM_ROOT.description: Root directory containing multi-repository subject checkouts evaluated across ecosystem benchmarks.

LIBSCRIPT_EXPERIMENT_LOCKFILE_DIR.description: Directory containing pinned provenance lockfiles (e.g., c_upstreams.lock.json and batch_wild_corpus.lock.json).

LIBSCRIPT_EXPERIMENT_EMULATION_MODE.description: Controlled execution or baseline isolation mode ('native_only', 'wine_warm', 'wine_cold', 'wsl2_loopback', 'wsl2_cross_boundary', 'wsl2_cli_spawn', 'cygwin', 'msys2', or 'dos32_vagrant_com1').

LIBSCRIPT_BENCH_REQUIRE_NATIVE_ISA.description: Flag (0 or 1) enforcing native hardware ISA execution and rejecting Rosetta 2, QEMU, or WoW64 binary translation.

LIBSCRIPT_BENCH_CARGO_PROFILE.description: Pinned Cargo release profile specification ('opt3-lto-thin-cgu1' or custom key=value list) enforced across Rust benchmarks.

LIBSCRIPT_BENCH_MSVC_CRT.description: MSVC C Runtime linkage variant ('MT' for static CRT or 'MD' for dynamic CRT) applied during Windows benchmark builds.

LIBSCRIPT_BENCH_WINE_MODE.description: WINE baseline execution policy ('warm' for persistent wineserver -p or 'cold' for per-trial wineserver -k).

LIBSCRIPT_BENCH_FAKE_TRANSLATED_ISA.description: Internal test override flag (0 or 1) simulating Rosetta/QEMU binary translation to test RULE-2 failure handling.

LIBSCRIPT_BENCH_CLOCK_NS_BIN.description: Cached path to the compiled C11 monotonic nanosecond clock helper executable.

LIBSCRIPT_BENCH_PROBE_BIN.description: Cached path to the compiled C11 cross-OS subprocess timing and PeakWorkingSetSize/ru_maxrss measurement probe.

LIBSCRIPT_HW_CPU_MODEL.description: Detected host CPU or SoC model string exported by libscript_detect_hardware.

LIBSCRIPT_HW_PHYS_CORES.description: Detected host physical CPU core count exported by libscript_detect_hardware.

LIBSCRIPT_HW_PERF_CORES.description: Detected host performance CPU core count exported by libscript_detect_hardware.

LIBSCRIPT_HW_NUMA_NODES.description: Detected host NUMA node count exported by libscript_detect_hardware.
